
```{r ga-population}
set.seed(4)
m = 7233584
n = 625

b0 = floor(.7*m)
b1 = ceiling(.3*m)
y0 = rbinom(n=b0,size=1,prob=.68)
y1 = rbinom(n=b1,size=1,prob=.74)
dfpop = data.frame(y=c(y0,y1), x=c(rep(0,b0),rep(1,b1)))
dfpop = dfpop[sample(1:m),] # shuffle the rows
x = dfpop$x
y = dfpop$y
```

```{r ga-sample}
# Generate Sample Data for us (J1) and three friends (J2,J3,JM)
set.seed(0)
J1 = sample(1:m,size=n,replace=T)
J2 = sample(1:m,size=n,replace=T)
J3 = sample(1:m,size=n,replace=T)
JM = sample(1:m,size=n,replace=T)

J = J1
dfsam = dfpop[J,]
X = dfsam$x
Y = dfsam$y
```

```{r ga-maps}
#| cache: true
library(usmap)
ga.shape = us_map(include = c("GA"))

# Create fake locations for the people in our population
# by taking random convex combinations of state vertices
# To reduce computation, we'll have 10K locations + jitter
L = 10000 
V = nrow(ga.shape)
weights = abs(rt(L*V,1))
dim(weights) = c(L,V)
weights = (1/rowSums(weights)) * weights 
base.x = weights %*% ga.shape$x
base.y = weights %*% ga.shape$y
base.ind = 1 + ( (0:(m-1)) %% L )
locations = data.frame(x=base.x[base.ind] + rnorm(m, sd=.01),
                       y=base.y[base.ind] + rnorm(m, sd=.01))

ga = ggplot() + 
    geom_polygon(data=ga.shape, aes(x = x, y = y), 
                 fill="white", color="black") + 
    coord_fixed() + blank.theme
```
